name: 33761 · Clearwater, FL
findings: ZIP 33761 (Clearwater) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33761 (Clearwater) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33761 (Clearwater) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 65% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
